items.title: Sammy Penn Interview, 1960-04-21
items.q: I still played with him some down here in New Orleans. ... I played with him, I stayed with him about three years.

ctx.x: I was going to ask, did any of the New Orleans bands come over there on any special holidays or anything that you can remember when you were young?

Well I can't remember. A band used to come from New Orleans by a name, Jewel Barnes. He was a trammond player and he was a manager of the band. Used to come from New Orleans to play in Morgan City. Was that a dance band or a brass band? That was a good band. A dance? A dance band. And I used to sit around on the bandstand until I'd get a chance to try to play with the boys and sometimes he'd let me play. So he kept telling me, why don't you come to New Orleans? He said, you're too good to be out here. Jewel…
Well wait a minute, how old would you be then when you did finally come here?
